runtime_validation.historical_note: Original integration evidence. Gameplay was revised on 2026-10-10; current rules are in gameplay and opening.runtime_override.
runtime_validation.scope: Latest imported GLBs: five real-controller loops, eleven save/continue checks, three-item crossroads gate and next-layer transition.
runtime_validation.content_state: Development event controls and NPC placeholders; formal narration, task content and user video deferred.

coordinate_conversion: Blender (x,y,z) -> Godot (x,z,-y). Positions below are Blender coordinates; feet positions, not camera positions.

EntrySealTrigger.description: Close and lock entry after player steps down first stairs; spawn and trigger feet differ in elevation. Never reload old basement by returning upstairs.

collision.dynamic_doors: Create box collider under each door pivot using closed_leaf_local_center and leaf_size; do not bake leaf into static collision.

screen.uv: 0..1 bottom-left to top-right, screen is front -Y in asset space
screen.recommended_runtime: VideoStreamPlayer -> SubViewport -> unshaded StandardMaterial3D; native .ogv; point light separate from video brightness
screen.standby: Green phosphor screen when no video; retain original video mesh/UV; local green fill separate from screen material.

opening.gate_rule: User-revised opening: wait at least 10 seconds, finish knocking sound, then nearby F interaction starts full-door opening cinematic and fade into basement; do not bypass before knocking completion

runtime_override.asset_distance_note: door_distance=18.0 and the exported spawn/hinge coordinates in this opening section describe the unchanged GLB source. The values below override gameplay at runtime; the legacy 10-second gate_rule is superseded.
runtime_override.interaction_unlock: The entire positional knock must finish before nearby F can open the door.
runtime_override.opening_motion: 0.35-second camera approach, then 1.6-second door opening with continuous camera advance through the doorway.
runtime_override.pause_rule: Settings pause the black reveal timer, knock audio, door and camera motion.

opening.moving_leaf: All panels and handle parented to OpeningDoorPivot; frame and light seams remain fixed. Add dynamic leaf collision in Godot.

gameplay.purpose: First-chapter tutorial; all first-chapter NPCs appear in basement rounds, no NPCs or quest hotspots at the crossroads
gameplay.terminal_rule: Social feed and notebook are available inside CRT from the first visit, sharing phone progress and vocabulary. Phone social unlocks after visit 1 help and notebook after visit 3 help. Babel is retired; visit 5 still requires NPC help before the exit opens.
gameplay.crossroads_gate_rule: Require both phone permissions and all five completed NPC tasks; legacy gate items or Babel permission cannot substitute for either requirement.

runtime_door_flow.basement_exit: The ordinary ExitDoorPivot door opens directly into the next room. No second white door, black tunnel, exterior pocket or intermediate scene.
runtime_door_flow.white_door_scope: Opening sequence only; never used between basement visits.
runtime_door_flow.transition_cover: None: camera keeps moving during door opening and reaches the destination-matched pose before the room is replaced.
runtime_door_flow.room_connection: Visits 1-4 show the aligned next basement entrance. Visit 5 shows the live crossroads through the physical door aperture.
runtime_door_flow.preview_xray_rule: Destination scenery excludes all X-ray-only geometry; only the current room supplies live hand-window clues.
runtime_door_flow.source_geometry_policy: GLB dimensions, anchors and door hinges in the source geometry sections remain unchanged. At runtime Exit_Vestibule meshes and their matching colliders are disabled, retaining the door and frame. Legacy exit_tunnel_entered saves normalize to the safe current basement.

gameplay.crt_vhs_rule: Persistent settings toggle affecting CRT display content only; video interface retained

dressing.route_clearance: Turn at stair foot near y=-3.35, cross room near y=-2.85, then approach right passage at x=2.4.

art_direction.furniture: original walnut/wood and original stickers; no green material tint
art_direction.walls: green woven wallpaper with subtle pattern and vertical seams
art_direction.lighting: dim lightly green room; upstairs entry fixture excluded; green CRT localized spill
art_direction.enclosure: Complete TV corner walls and ceiling; first-person camera at 1.65 m; no cutaway display

xray_exit_guides.visibility_rule: Existing camera X-ray hand-framed window only; not visible to normal world camera or ordinary camera. Hide on camera off, lost framing, phone UI or leaving basement.

marks.purpose: At stair foot: turn right across TV zone
Right wall: continue toward rear NPC passage
Rear wall: point left toward ground-floor exit door
